subject: Co-sell marketplace demo: aligning runbook + engineering slot
messages:
From: Ellie Shawell <ellie@helixsystems.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 27 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Helix x Redwood marketplace co-sell: initial slot options

Hi Rafael / Vanessa / Karthik,

Thanks again for the introduction at last week's partner huddle. Helix is ready to run the joint marketplace showcase for the Proof-of-Concept customers (APAC + US pilots). Jordan from the AWS partner team will join for the marketplace listing portion. High level ask: schedule a 60-min co-sell demo + 30-min optional deep-dive for SI engineers.

Key constraints from our side:
- Primary presenters: Ellie (product) + Mark Chen (SI lead)
- Need a Redwood engineer for model/latency Q&A (20 min)
- Want a rehearsal 30–45m 48 hours before the customer demo
- Prefer US mornings or APAC late afternoons (we're bridging two pilots)

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue Jul 6, 09:30–11:00
- Wed Jul 7, 08:00–09:30 (rehearsal-friendly)
- Fri Jul 9, 11:00–12:30

I've attached a short demo outline and our suggested runbook. CC'd Jordan from AWS to confirm marketplace checklist. Can you confirm Redwood availability and who'd lead the technical deep-dive?

Thanks,
Ellie

--
Ellie Shawell
Strategic Partnerships, Helix Systems
ellie@helixsystems.com
attachments: helix-demo-outline-v2.pdf (PDF, 420KB)
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Helix x Redwood marketplace co-sell: initial slot options

Ellie — thanks for the clear runbook. Great to have Jordan joining.

Quick answers and constraints from our side:
- I can lead the opening and business narrative.
- Vanessa to coordinate the engineering deep-dive; Soojin (infra) will join the deep-dive for latency/quantization discussion.
- We prefer Tue Jul 6 or Fri Jul 9; Jul 7 rehearsal is OK but we have an internal all-hands at 08:30 PT that day.

Two asks from Redwood:
1) Can Helix confirm customer attendee list (prod owners vs execs) so we can tailor the demo?
2) Please add a rehearsal ICS so our infra team can block calendar.

I'm attaching a short preflight checklist we use for marketplace demos (screenshots + runbook slots). Proposing we lock a rehearsal on Mon Jul 5 09:00 PT if you can accommodate.

Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.com

Thanks Rafael — attaching the attendee matrix (roles + timezones).

We can do the rehearsal Mon Jul 5 at 09:00 PT and the customer demo Tue Jul 6 at 09:30 PT. Mark (SI) can join the deep-dive slot immediately after the main demo.

One small note from AWS: Jordan asked that the marketplace checklist segment be ~12 minutes to cover listing flow, procurement steps, and billing expectations. Jordan — can you confirm you can join the main demo at 09:30 PT?

Ellie

Subject: Re: Helix x Redwood marketplace co-sell: initial slot options

All — I'm good for Jul 6 main demo and Jul 5 rehearsal. A couple of operational notes from CS/SE side:

- For the deep-dive we need 25–30 minutes to show the latency profile, quantization tradeoffs, and request-level tracing in Console. So please ensure the SI engineer (Mark) can cover the first 10 minutes while Soojin and I walk through traces.
- Can Helix share the customer SSO domain(s) ahead of the rehearsal so we can validate auth flows? That saves 10 minutes during the call.
- We'll run recording + transcript; is Helix OK with sharing the recording to the customer and AWS? (need opt-in confirmation for the recording)

I'll prep a short troubleshooting checklist for the rehearsal and share as a GDrive link.

V.

See you all Monday. I attached a calendar invite ICS for the demo + rehearsal.
